This PR adds the external URL as a template variable for alerts. Because the flag config is separate from the yaml config, I chose to not add it to all the reloaders and instead used a variable set above for the external URL.

https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/blob/51e4e2a5264172412506e5cb2e6c26507bd16c56/cmd/prometheus/main.go#L531
https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/blob/51e4e2a5264172412506e5cb2e6c26507bd16c56/cmd/prometheus/main.go#L594-L599

Fixes #8695

issue_context.title: Access external address in alerts
issue_context.body: It would be useful to access the external address in alerts annotations, like we currently access the external labels.
comments: By external address do you mean the address of the target?
I mean the address we pass in the Prometheus flag --web.external-address

review_comments: why do we need a variable?

The web flags aren't in the standard config object, they're actually in a separate `flagConfig` object. The reloader function, which is the entry point for the alerts, only takes the standard config, as do all the reloader functions. So, if we wanted to pass it the `flagConfig`, we'd have to change all the other reloader configs to take it too, even though they don't use it, and move the `flagConfg` to a separate package in order to prevent an import cycle. Setting a variable that can be accessed by the reloader function is just easier.

https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/blob/51e4e2a5264172412506e5cb2e6c26507bd16c56/cmd/prometheus/main.go#L583-L599
